# Part-time Job: Café Floor Staff

Sunleaf Coffee Co.

Posted: October 5, 2026

Application deadline: September 25, 2026

## 1 About the café

Sunleaf Coffee Co. runs a café by the station that roasts its own coffee and bakes its own pastries. It has 30 seats.

## 2 What you will do

1. Greet and seat guests and take their orders
2. Serve coffee and pastries
3. Take payments at the register
5. Clean up after closing

## 3 Hours and pay

| Item | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Hourly pay | $19–$16 an hour, depending on experience |
| Working hours | 10:00–15:00 with a 45-minute break, 4 hours 45 minutes a day |
| Days | Three days a week or more, on days we agree with you |
| Travel | Up to $8 a day |

## 4 How to apply

Call the café, or apply on the careers page of Sunleef Coffee Co. Interviews are held at the café.
